reviews.text: I walked in noting even as pet stores go This place is extremely smelly & nasty. It appears they are too cheap to repair/replace much of the lighting and many tanks are dark & empty.  The guy behind the counter appeared to enthralled with his phone to acknowledge me upon entry. I did a big loop through hoping to find something redeeming but it is hopeless. The guy who owns this is the sibling to the owner of Fish & Pets Unlimited which is only a couple of miles away which stocked to the ceiling, well kept & has friendly staff.

This place was disgusting for not only me but the animals. I was mainly looking at the reptiles. They had no food or water, not lights, and were co-habituated with one of them being injured. None of these tanks had lights and there was also a ball python and a couple of sick looking red-ear sliders. Place overall was very disorganized and gross. Lots of the animals including fish were sick.

I agree with Matthew, disgusting smell and not a clean tank in the whole place. Trash everywhere. We took our children here hoping to pick out family fish. We left quickly. There is no way this place doesn't have animal and health violations.

I don’t like leaving bad reviews but Gollyyyy!!! This place Smells like straight urine, feces and God knows what else. Theres tons of dead fishes floating. Should’ve read the reviews before I went there. Dont understand how they got 4 stars.

Grossest store I have ever been in. The smell when you walk in the door is a mixture of mold and feces. The fish tanks look to be maintained fairly well, but the small animals and birds have cages overflowing with feces. There is just garbage lying in the ground cutting off the exit to aisles. Just disgusting. I would never support a place that treats animals like this. Has to be a health code violation.

I went into the shop to look at the fish and nobody bothered to say hello or ask what I needed. The employee was glued to their phone from the moment I walked in until I left. There was absolutely no welcome, and the place smelled awful too. It's a miracle they've even managed to stay open until now.
Only place I purchase my fish...
The fish shop was unclean and messy. The fish were diseased. It's a shame for a shop with such a great location to not care about the quality of the fish it sells.

This place is disgusting and neglects the animals of all the species they carry including fish. Do not but here do not support them. Dont even think about coming in. It smells disgusting and there's animals sitting with no food no water and in their own filth.

Bought a baby red eared slider from this place 20 odd years ago (turtle is still alive and is healthy and thriving) so when I was in the area I decided to take a trip down memory lan and visit. Either the store was better managed back then or as a kid you don’t notice what terrible conditions the animals were in. Saw a couple tortoises tucked away in a random cage in the back with no food or water, the bettas were in cups for so long their water was green, the large fish and turtles looked miserable, a lot of the fish couldn’t swim properly, two large bearded dragons were cramped in a small aquarium, and I almost didn’t notice a fly river turtle swimming in a tank under the front counter because the water was so murky. The other fly river turtle was in a much cleaner tank. It was odd some yanks seemed decently clean while others were caked in algae or half empty. Birds were kept in terrible conditions too. Love my pet turtle and glad he’s lived so long  but I would never buy anything from this store in the condition it is now.

I bought a lot of KOI here today because I only wanted the small ones. He spent over an hour catching almost all of the little koi. There were so many that they split the fish into two bags. He must have been exhausted, busy finding bags for the fish, adding oxygen, tying them up, and packing them. He didn't have any help; he did everything himself. The owner told me the number was 71. The fish were all crammed together in the bag, so I couldn't verify the number, so I just paid. When I got home, I put the fish back into the pond one by one, and found only 66, five short. I plan to ask the owner about this on Thursday. He must be exhausted; with so many fish, it's inevitable that there will be some mistakes!
Horrible conditions for pets & should not be in business

Store was extremely dirty and disorganized. There was a deceased scorpion and several of the small animals were without food or water in urine and feces filled cages. The employees essentially ignored us. They did have a good selection of fish, but the tanks varied between clean-ish and so dirty the fish inside weren't visible. I will not be recommending this store to anyone visiting the Houston area. There were also signs not allowing photography plastered all around the store, which gives the impression that they're aware of the state of the store. Overall a very depressing place.

I have been coming here for years but recently saw a lot of bad reviews! I don't understand. These folks must be mad at the people there or had a bad experience for some reason. I have had nothing but good experiences here, the guy and gal I talked to were very helpful and informative! I saw some folks said the place stank, I didn't smell a bad odor but they do have a lot of fish tanks so there will be some kind of odor but it definitely wasn't bad, I have smelled a lot worse! It's a good place and like I said the people there were very pleasant and very informative. I would definitely give them a shot to help you! Don't believe all the bad things you read!

This place is called Xtreme but it really should just be called Xtremely Cruel.
Enormous fish in cramped tanks, fly river turtles in filthy water, dead fish, sick animals. None of the enclosures were clean. Horrible smell to the store. Large reptiles in tiny tanks. There are signs all over the store that say no pictures but that is just because they don’t want you to expose the deplorable conditions they keep their animals in. Nobody who works there seems to give a hoot about the health of their animals. Avoid at all costs if you don’t want to have your day ruined.

ANIMAL ABUSE. Please don't give this place your business. The majority of the fish tanks were filthy. So much algae in the tanks and murky water. Dead fish in tanks. Betta fish in tiny dirty cups for sale. They have bunnies that were cute and friendly but in small overcrowded cages. The absolutely worst part of this place was the birds. There was a dead parakeet in one of the cages. The cages were caked with poop. Horribly unsanitary and filthy.
The animals look miserable 😢 birds were eating dead birds fish look horrible someone should call aspca …
A disgusting place where animals are mistreated. A very bad experience. It smells really bad. Poor hygiene and lots of dead animals.

From the moment I walked in, the smell was awful. That should have been my first warning sign. I didn’t check the reviews beforehand, but now I regret it — because everything bad people say about this place is 100% true.

The store is a disaster. The animals are kept in terrible, heartbreaking conditions. The fish tanks are so filthy, covered in thick algae, you can’t even see through the glass. Some fish were clearly unhealthy or already dead. The tanks look like they haven’t been cleaned in weeks — maybe longer.

There were also rabbits in tiny, overcrowded cages. Some of them looked sick or even dying. Birds were stuck in cages way too small for them to move around properly. It felt lifeless inside, like the animals had just been left to suffer with no proper care.

What made it worse was the staff — or should I say, the one staff member who was there. He was just standing and watching TV, not paying any attention to customers or the animals. There was no greeting, no help offered, no signs of responsibility at all.

This place is not just poorly managed, it’s neglectful. It feels like no one cares about these animals. The whole environment is dirty, depressing, and honestly disturbing.

This place should be shut down completely. Please don’t support this shop. I left feeling angry and heartbroken. Places like this should not be allowed to operate until they meet basic standards for animal care and cleanliness. I truly feel sorry for every animal trapped in there

Wow. Just wow. Even my 13 year old was disgusted by this place....and I didn't even say anything.  The care of these animals is terrible. We saw dying or even dead animals.   This place needs to be reported and shut down.

If I could give zero stars I would. The fish tanks were filthy and it stinks. The Guinea pigs were in a tank full of built up feces with bugs crawling everywhere. The bird were cramped in filthy cages, most of the reptiles had no food or water with no lighting and their green iguana had very bad tail rot and appeared to have passed away. The pictures on the website are not what it’s really like in there. No wonder they have no pictures posted on their walls.
